item.title: For 1st time, automated system lands plane safely after loss of pressurization
item.description: For the first time, a Garmin system successfully auto-landed a Beechcraft Super King Air 200 after an in-flight emergency, with two people emerging unharmed.

item.title: 2-vehicle crash on North Keystone Avenue leaves child dead, 3 others hurt
item.description: One of 4 children injured in a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of North Keystone Avenue and East 34th Street has died, police say.

item.title: Pediatrician weighs in on the rise of carnivore baby diet
item.description: (WISH) — Do you get advice about what your baby should be eating on your phone every day? From standard American to vegetarian to vegan, there’s many different options. However, there’s a new trend that takes the steak. Everyone needs food to live, so the decision of what to feed your baby is very important. […]

item.title: Deadly blasts and fire hit Pennsylvania nursing home
item.description: Authorities said two people were killed and five were missing after a gas leak caused an explosion and fire at a nursing home near Philadelphia. A search for victims was happening in the collapsed portion of the building.

item.title: Arrest made in connection with fatal shooting of girl in Marion
item.description: A 22-year-old man was arrested in Marion, Indiana, in connection with the fatal shooting of a girl at a home. The case is being investigated as a reckless homicide.

item.title: Pacers’ losing streak reaches 6 games as Bucks secure 111-94 win
item.description: The Milwaukee Bucks beat the Indiana Pacers 111-94 on Tuesday night at Gainbridge Fieldhouse. T.J. McConnell led the Pacers, who dropped their sixth consecutive game, with 16 points off the bench.

item.title: Illinois’ new law for medically assisted suicide disappoints native, Pope Leo XIV
item.description: Pope Leo XIV expressed disappointment that Illinois, where he was born, had approved a law allowing medically assisted suicide. He called for greater respect of life, "especially in these Christmas days."

item.title: Pedestrian fatally struck by 3 cars in Whitley County crash
item.description: A 32-year-old pedestrian, Vicente Ramos, was killed in a three-vehicle crash on US 24 in Whitley County, Indiana on Monday.

item.title: Carmel is 1st city in Indiana to deploy Pursuit Alert for driver safety
item.description: Carmel is the first city in Indiana to offer a notification system, Pursuit Alert, which is equipped in nearly 90% of the Carmel Police Department's patrol vehicles to alert drivers of nearby emergency vehicles responding to emergencies.

item.title: IMPD makes arrest after fatal shooting of man found in crashed car
item.description: Indianapolis police have arrested one person in connection with a fatal Tuesday afternoon shooting in Camby.
